content.text: Found a latent bug: `op in ATOM_OPS` (a frozenset) raises `TypeError` for unhashable `op` values. Let me fix:

cd /workspace && python3 - << 'PYEOF'
p='submission/main.py'; s=open(p).read()
s = s.replace("ATOM_OPS = frozenset(('match', 'startswith', 'endswith', 'contains'))",
              "# a tuple on purpose: membership must not hash the (untrusted) op value\nATOM_OPS = ('match', 'startswith', 'endswith', 'contains')")
open(p,'w').write(s)
